review_candidates.title: Junior CRM Specialist, AI-first (HCM)
review_candidates.location: Củ Chi, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
review_candidates.description: Now hiring CRM Junior CRM Specialist, AI-first Bring AI into our lifecycle marketing. From day one you will produce newsletters hands-on and help turn 'we should use AI for this' into flows that actually run: smarter segmentation, generated content at scale, personalization that would take a human team weeks. This AI capability is new to the team, and you will help shape how we build it. About The Role Have you started using AI in marketing work, and want to go deep on it in a real CRM role? We are honest: AI is the skill our CRM team is light on today. That is exactly why this role exists, and why you do not need years of it to join. TCG's CRM team runs lifecycle messaging across 20+ shops, and AI is the capability we are deliberately adding. Think of this as a hands-on, AI-first CRM role: you produce newsletters from day one while pairing marketing basics with practical AI (content generation, predictive segmentation, personalization, workflow automation), and help the team use it responsibly, with a human always on the last mile. The Customization Group is a global leader in mass customization and print-on-demand e-commerce. We manufacture up to 2.5 million unique, personalized products daily across production sites in Germany, Poland, the USA and Latvia. Millions of customers find us through our 20+ online shops and 1,000+ partner stores. AI applied to that scale of customer data is the opportunity this role gets to work on. In a nutshell - run hands-on newsletter production and make our CRM smarter with AI (content, segmentation, personalization), learning and leveling up as you go. At a glance Location Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam Full-time Onsite Team CRM / Lifecycle reporting into CRM leadership Scope AI-first CRM newsletters content segments Hours Overlap with CET Riga & Cologne core hours (probably from 10 AM to 7 PM Vietnam time) Travel Occasional trips to our Riga office Experience Typically 1+ years CRM, lifecycle or email + AI Start date Flexible around your notice period The role in detail What you will do, and what we need from you. Side by side, no surprises. What You Will Do Day-to-day, week-to-week. Real work, with support while you find your feet. → Produce newsletters, hands-on. From day one you build and ship regular newsletters end to end: this is a working production seat, not only an AI layer on top. → Generate content at scale. Use AI to draft and adapt campaign copy across shops, languages and segments, with a human reviewing the last mile. → Sharpen segmentation. Apply AI and predictive approaches to find the right customers: churn risk, next-best-offer, lifetime value. → Personalize the message. Build dynamic, AI-assisted personalization into lifecycle flows. → Automate the busywork. Turn repetitive CRM tasks into AI-assisted workflows the team can reuse. → Share what works. Document the prompts and approaches that work, so the team can reuse them. Requirements What we genuinely need. Short list on purpose, and you do not need to tick every box. Must have → 1+ years in CRM, lifecycle or email marketing. Internships and hands-on projects count. → You already use AI in your day-to-day. You can prompt AI tools well enough to get useful output, even if not at an expert level. We do not expect you to build agents, but we do want someone who already works with AI and is eager to go deeper. → Some exposure to a CRM/ESP platform, such as Emarsys, Iterable, Braze or CleverTap, or a genuine willingness to learn one fast. → You judge AI output critically. You know when it is good enough and when it is not. → Reliable daily overlap with European (CET) hours. Our CRM team sits in Riga and Cologne. → Working-level English for a globally distributed team. Why this role AI in CRM at TCG is a capability being built, not a buzzword being decorated. Here is what is actually true right now. Greenfield You help build the capability AI in CRM is new here, so you are not maintaining someone's legacy setup, you are helping set it up. First mover | Your playbook Scale Real material to work with 20+ shops and rich product and order data give AI something genuine to bite into. 20+ shops | Rich data Grow Learn by building You build real AI and CRM skills from the ground up, with mentoring and room to grow fast. Mentoring | Fast growth Tooling The AI + CRM stack Emarsys as the CRM core, agentic AI already in daily use across the company, and you help shape what the CRM team adopts next. Emarsys | Agentic AI | Room to grow Who We Are Looking For Two short lists. The 'probably not a fit' column is on purpose: it makes the first column more credible, and saves us both time. Sounds like you? → You have started using AI in real marketing work and want to go further. → You like being early on something new. → You are pragmatic: output that ships beats a clever demo. → You keep a human in the loop and can explain why. Probably not a fit if → You want a mature AI setup to plug into. Here you are helping build it. → You treat AI output as final without review. We keep humans on the last mile. → You would rather run classic campaigns than push into new methods. → Time-zone overlap with European colleagues does not work for you. What We Offer The essentials, done properly, plus the parts that matter locally. → Build something new AI capability from the ground up → Modern AI + CRM stack internal AI tools + Emarsys → International exposure globally distributed teams → Local benefits health coverage, paid leave and local perks How We Hire Four steps. About three weeks. No surprises: we tell you who you will meet, what they will ask, and roughly how long each step takes. 1 Day 1-3 Async You apply Short application and CV. Reviewed by Talent and the CRM Lead. Reviewed by Talent + the CRM Lead 2 Day 4-7 30 min Recruiter call Mutual scoping with the Talent team. You meet Talent team 3 Day 8-14 60-90 min Hiring manager + practical A conversation with the CRM Lead, plus a short task: show how you would use AI to improve one real lifecycle flow. You meet the CRM Lead 4 Day 15-21 Async Offer or no A final conversation, then a decision. Written feedback either way. Outcome Final call You will always know where you stand. We give written feedback at every stage, even when it is a no. We never ghost, and the whole process runs in about three weeks. Ready to apply? No cover letter required. A few short prompts help us understand how you think. Answer them in the application, or bring your answers to the recruiter call.

review_candidates.title: International Business Development Executive
review_candidates.description: Scale To Unicorn is a growth and revenue acceleration company helping ambitious businesses acquire customers, generate qualified leads, and scale revenue through performance marketing, AI-powered sales systems, automation, and growth strategies. Founded by an IIT Delhi entrepreneur, we work with businesses across international markets, helping them turn marketing investments into measurable business growth. We aren't building another traditional agency. We're building a growth company with global ambitions. THE OPPORTUNITY Can you turn a cold conversation into a business opportunity? We are looking for a sharp, ambitious, and persuasive International Business Development Executive who can help us acquire clients across the USA, UK, UAE, and Canada. You will work directly with the founding team, communicate with international business owners, identify potential clients, pitch our solutions, negotiate deals, and help close revenue-generating partnerships. This is not a job where you sit around waiting for leads. You find opportunities. You start conversations. You create revenue. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES International Client Acquisition Identify and approach potential clients across the USA, UK, UAE, and Canada. Generate qualified leads through LinkedIn, email, cold calling, and other outbound channels. Build relationships with founders, CEOs, marketing heads, and business owners. Sales & Business Development Understand client business challenges and identify growth opportunities. Pitch our performance marketing, lead generation, AI automation, and growth solutions. Conduct discovery calls, follow-ups, negotiations, and sales conversations. Convert qualified prospects into paying international clients. Revenue & Relationship Management Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and track daily outreach activities. Follow up consistently with prospective clients. Coordinate with the internal marketing and operations teams. Build long-term relationships and identify opportunities for upselling. WHO SHOULD APPLY? Excellent spoken and written English. Confident communicating with international clients. Strong persuasion, negotiation, and communication skills. Comfortable with cold calling, emailing, and LinkedIn outreach. Self-driven, competitive, and target-oriented. Interested in international business, entrepreneurship, sales, and marketing. Familiarity with CRM tools, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or email outreach is an advantage. Freshers with exceptional communication skills and hunger to succeed are welcome. WHAT YOU GET Fixed monthly salary + performance-based incentives. Attractive commissions on successfully closed deals. Direct mentorship and exposure to an IIT Delhi founder. Opportunity to work with international businesses and decision-makers. Hands-on experience in global sales, business strategy, and entrepreneurship. A fast-paced environment where performance matters more than designations. Opportunity to grow into an International Business Development Manager role. THE KIND OF PERSON WE WANT We don't care much about fancy degrees or impressive resumes. We care about whether you can: Pick up the phone and confidently speak with a business owner. Handle rejection without losing momentum. Think on your feet and persuade intelligently. Take ownership instead of waiting for instructions. Deliver results without constant supervision. We are looking for people who want to build careers, not just complete working hours.

review_candidates.title: Interface Management Engineer @Siemens Mobility Egypt
review_candidates.description: Siemens Mobility (SMO) is the world’s leading provider of mobility solutions that enable the efficient, safe, and environmentally friendly transport of people and goods—helping to improve the quality of everyday life for millions worldwide. Motivated by innovation, we develop intelligent solutions for the growing digitalization of the transport sector. Our offerings include rail vehicles, rail automation, road traffic management systems, rail electrification, and services. In Egypt, Siemens Mobility is delivering one of the country’s first high-speed rail system. This landmark project, spanning approximately 2,000 kilometers, will connect 60 cities across Egypt, transforming transportation for both passengers and goods. Participating in this project could be a pivotal milestone in your career and a significant historical achievement for the region. Today, we are recruiting for a Interface Management Engineer to join our team in Egypt. This is an excellent career opportunity for professionals looking to join a truly international team in one of the biggest projects of Siemens Mobility. What are my responsibilities? Identify and manage technical, operational and organizational interfaces, dependencies and responsibilities across maintenance functions and external stakeholders. Develop and maintain interface registers, matrices and action trackers, ensuring clear ownership, deadlines and follow-up. Coordinate cross-functional meetings, clarify requirements and follow up on decisions and outstanding actions. Resolve and escalate interface gaps, conflicts, changes and risks affecting maintenance readiness and delivery. Coordinate with Maintenance Delivery, Operations, Engineering, Asset Management, Quality and consortium partners to align workflows, handovers and information exchange. Monitor interface progress, report key issues and dependencies to management, and support operational readiness, audits and continuous improvement. Identify potential cost, resource and safety impacts of unresolved interfaces and escalate them accordingly. What do I need to qualify for this job? Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Railway Systems, Industrial Engineering or a related technical discipline. 3–5 years of relevant experience in interface coordination, systems/project engineering or railway operations and maintenance. Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and managing interface requirements, dependencies and action registers. Understanding of railway systems, maintenance processes and complex infrastructure or safety-critical projects. Strong English communication, stakeholder management, facilitation and problem-solving skills. Ability to analyze technical and organizational dependencies, clarify responsibilities and manage cross-functional processes. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, document management systems and interface tracking tools. What else do I need to know? As a world leader in developing and producing the most advanced technologies, we improve lives and further human achievements worldwide, while also protecting the climate - all thanks to our employees. Working with us, you have the foundation to develop personally and professionally. We give you the chance to do something significant that benefits society and human progress. We give you the chance to create a difference. At Siemens we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse Digital Minds to develop tomorrow ‘s reality. Find out more about the Digital world of Siemens here: www.siemens.com/careers/digitalminds Diversity at Siemens is our source of creativity and innovation. Having different types of talent and experiences makes us more ambitious and better prepared to respond successfully to the demands of the Society. Therefore, we value the candidates that reflect the Diversity that we enjoy in our Company. Please find more information at www.siemens.com We are looking forward to receiving your online application. Please note: Only complete applications can be considered in the selection process.

review_candidates.description: Votre prochain Challenge : Conduire des projets vers leur succès, c’est quelque chose qui vous plait ? Ce poste d’Ingénieur projet / PMO (H/F) est fait pour vous ! 🎯 Qui êtes-vous ?🔎 Le métier d’ingénieur projet / PMO vous demandera des capacités d’adaptation élevées, un sens du service développé et un professionnalisme de haute qualité. ➡ Dans ce cadre là, votre profil correspond il à ces critères ? ▪ Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation Ingénieur / Mastère Spécialisé (Bac+5/+6).🎓 ▪ Vous justifiez d’une première expérience en gestion de projet, dans un environnement industriel. ▪ Vous êtes fluent en français et maîtrisé l'anglais. ▪ Vous êtes doté d'un très bon relationnel et souhaitez apporter de la valeur ajoutée dans tout ce que vous entreprenez ▪ Vous êtes reconnu pour votre leadership, votre esprit de synthèse ▪ Vous savez faire preuve de polyvalence et de curiosité Si oui, n’hésitez plus à postuler ! Chez MIGSO-PCUBED, nous apprécions particulièrement les personnes authentiques et nous mettons un point d’honneur à recruter des équipes où les talents individuels s’épanouissent grâce à l’émulation et le soutien de chacun. Nous souhaitons que chacun de nos collaborateurs fasse partie intégrante de notre équipe internationale, et nous engageons à construire une entreprise qui soit représentative de la société́ dans son ensemble, où chacun se sente inclus, libre de partager ses idées et bénéficie de l’égalité́ des chances. Votre futur environnement : Bienvenue chez MIGSO-PCUBED, le leader mondial du conseil en Management de Projet et PMO. Notre mission au quotidien ? Aider nos clients à transformer leurs plus grandes idées en réalité́.🌟 📍 Localisation : Nice et sa périphérie 🖋 Nature du contrat : CDI Pour répondre à cet objectif, et dans le cadre du développement des activités de notre agence Parisienne, nous recrutons notre futur ou future Ingénieur.e projet / PMO (poste de consultant). Vous rejoindrez ainsi les équipes de Paul notre Responsable d’Agence, et travaillerez pour le compte de nos clients, grands industriels ✈,🚗,🚂,💡... pour l’accompagner dans la gestion, le suivi et la livraison de projets de haute technologie. Plus d’informations sur la typologie de projets vous seront communiquées lors de l’entretien. Votre poste sera essentiellement localisé à Nice et ses alentours sur site client, ainsi que X jour(s) par semaine dans notre agence M|P à Nice. En fonction des accords client, des jour(s) de télétravail par semaine pourront également être autorisés. Dès le début de votre mission, vous intégrerez une équipe consultant(s) PMO, et serez accompagné dans votre quotidien par votre Delivery Manager 🤝, pour une intégration et une montée en compétence professionnelle maîtrisée. Un Business Manager vous suivra également dans votre parcours et évolution dans l’entreprise. Votre rôle et missions : En tant qu’ingénieur projet et expert PMO, votre rôle sera de comprendre les challenges spécifiques liés à votre environnement, de donner de la capacité d’anticipation à votre client, et de proposer des solutions adaptées au projet. Vous serez orienté services, résultats, et satisfaction client. Vos principaux challenges seront les suivants : ▪ Conseiller votre client et être un acteur majeur de la réussite du projet ▪ Récupérer les données sur les composantes PMO du projet ( planning, coûts, risques, ressources, … ), ▪ Analyser & synthétiser la data pour élaborer les indicateurs nécessaires au suivi d’avancement du projet. ▪ Travailler en partenariat avec les différentes parties prenantes dans le but d’anticiper et de gérer les dérives. ▪ Recommander à votre client les meilleures solutions pour garantir la performance du projet. ▪ Contribuer à l’innovation des méthodes et outils du management de projet. En tant que consultant MIGSO-PCUBED, vous aurez l’opportunité́ durant votre parcours de collaborer avec les marques les plus reconnues de nombreux domaines industriels, d’interagir avec des personnes d’horizons différents à travers le monde, d’apprendre et de partager auprès de nos communautés d’expertises, d’exercer des responsabilités et de diriger des projets d’envergure. Cette expérience vous permettra d’acquérir de nouvelles compétences, de renforcer vos performances, et de devenir un véritable expert et leader en Management de Projet. Vos avantages en nous rejoignant : Rejoindre, MIGSO-PCUBED, c’est rejoindre une entreprise proposant bien plus qu’un simple job ! L’esprit d’équipe est au cœur de notre ADN ✌, et nos valeurs et notre mindset ne s’arrêtent pas à la porte du bureau. Nous nous entraidons, nous impliquons sur des sujets transverses, nous engageons en matière de RSE, et passons des moments mémorables ensemble. Notre culture d’entreprise, tournée vers le renforcement de l’expérience collaborateurs, vous offrira de nombreuses opportunités de développement : - Des parcours professionnels clairement définis pour progresser dans votre branche métier - Des opportunités d’évolution variées durant votre parcours (mobilité mission, géographique, fonctionnelle, ...) - Une forte culture de l’apprentissage, avec notamment l’accès libre à des milliers de formation - Un réseau social interne, pour développer votre réseau professionnel, même à l’international - La possibilité de vous engager sur des sujets transverses & RSE grâce à notre plateforme d’Ambassadeurs Pour ce poste, la fourchette de rémunération annuelle brute est comprise entre 35 000 € et 50 000 €, selon le profil et l’expérience. Votre processus de recrutement : Chez MIGSO-PCUBED, l’expérience candidat est aussi importante que l’expérience collaborateurs. Bien plus qu’un entretien, il s’agit d’un échange ouvert, basé sur l’écoute, la bienveillance et la transparence. 3 principales phases ponctuent le processus de recrutement : ✍ 1. Un 1er échange téléphonique avec l’un de nos recruteurs pour s’assurer que les attentes des 2 parties soient alignées. 2. Un entretien d'1h avec l’un de nos Business Managers pour parler du poste et des soft-skills requises. 3. Un dernier entretien d'1h30 avec l’un de nos encadrants pour tester la partie technique et vérifier le background. Notre objectif : vous faire vivre une expérience positive quelle que soit l’issue du recrutement, et vous faire un retour personnalisé dans les plus brefs délais. Sans retour de notre part sous 1 semaine, cela signifie que votre candidature n'est pas retenue.

This role exercises independent judgment in evaluating and improving HR technology and reporting processes, troubleshooting system-level issues, and partnering with U.S. HR leadership, Redeployment, Compensation, Talent Acquisition, Finance, IT, and global HR teams to reduce manual work and reporting risk. Essential Job Functions Systems Administration & Data Governance Serve as day-to-day administrator of core HRIS (Oracle) modules, ensuring data accuracy, timely updates, and consistent system configuration. Own evaluation of the current reporting inventory to determine which reports can be eliminated, consolidated, scheduled, or moved to self-service from a single governed data source. Partner with Compensation and global HR teams to clarify report and data ownership, particularly where global reporting and audit work depend on Compensation data.
